fields.description: The shared spec/type code from the legacy sheet, e.g. 100642. Multiple physical wheels (Wheels) share this Code.
fields.label: Code

fields.description: Unchecked (from the Shape) means Wheels of this Type are tracked as simply usable/not-usable via Wheel Usability Check, not caliper measurement — see PRD v9.
fields.label: Requires Measurement

fields.description: Linked ERPNext Item. A Material Receipt Stock Entry against this Item auto-creates Wheel records.
fields.label: Item

fields.description: The full spec string from the legacy sheet, preserved as-is for reference/search. Grit/concentration/bond codes are often concatenated into this string in ways that aren't reliably auto-parseable into the structured fields below — see PRD v3.
fields.label: Legacy Spec Name

fields.description: For flat/straight shapes (1A1, P-series), enter this directly — it's the wheel's full height/width. For profiled shapes it's read-only, auto-set to the sum of the Profile Segments' heights below.
fields.label: Original Diamond Layer Height (mm)

fields.description: Informational only — not used in the volume formula.
fields.label: Total Body Height (mm)

fields.description: The abrasive band's profile, as one or more conical segments walked from the (wearing) outer diameter inward to the (constant) bore. One row = a simple single-bevel shape like 1V1. Two rows = a compound/stepped shape like 11V9 or 12V9 (a main cone plus a separate chamfer near the bore, each with its own angle) — order matters, first row starts at the outer face. See PRD v7.
fields.label: Profile Segments

fields.description: When checked, Original Volume is recalculated from the dimensions above whenever they change. Uncheck to enter a manufacturer-specified value instead.
fields.label: Auto-Calculate Original Volume

fields.description: Flat shapes: (pi/4) x (D² - d²) x Diamond Height. Profiled shapes: exact conical-frustum-ring volume, summed across the Profile Segments below. Editable — override if a manufacturer spec sheet disagrees.
fields.label: Original Volume (mm³)

fields.description: Original Volume x (1 - Usable Volume Floor %). The floor is never counted as usable.
fields.label: Usable Original Volume (mm³)

fields.description: Unit Cost ÷ Usable Original Volume. Used to allocate wear cost per job.
fields.label: Cost per mm³ (usable)

fields.description: Daily reorder check raises an alert when In Stock Wheels of this Type fall below this count.
fields.label: Reorder Point

fields.description: Set by the daily reorder check. Cleared automatically once stock is replenished above the reorder point, so the next dip alerts again.
fields.label: Reorder Alert Active
